fact: On 19 May 2025 the digital transition minister announced a plan to connect over 1,000 secondary and health establishments to broadband by end 2025; the article cites 3,590 secondary establishments counted in 2024 and gives no share connected.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : Le gouvernement ivoirien prévoit de connecter, d'ici fin 2025, plus de 1000 établissements secondaires et sanitaires à Internet haut débit
